channel.description: Recent content in Projects on M Israr

item.title: Research Opportunity Portal: FastAPI + MySQL Web App
item.description: A full-stack web app where faculty post and manage research opportunities in one place, with a FastAPI REST API, a MySQL/MariaDB database, Pydantic validation and a plain JavaScript frontend.

item.title: radiq: Radial App Launcher for Hyprland
item.description: A Wayland-native, game-inspired radial application launcher for Arch Linux and Hyprland, built with Qt 6, QML and C++20 and published on the AUR.

item.title: ZephShell- Unix shell built in C
item.description: A Unix shell built from scratch in C to understand how shells actually work under the hood, process creation, command parsing, and execution from first principles.

item.title: Simfs- Simulated Linux filesystem
item.description: Used different Data structure(e.g n-ary tree) concepts to simulate Linux filesystem. you get terminal to interact with it .
